name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original procedural Blender Python authored with Codex
accuracy_notes: Reference-led silver interpretation of the original 1985 four-door Saga sedan. Formed body shoulders and continuous surface-fitted door seams, connected screen/pillar reveals, lightly bowed rounded glazing and flush roof headers follow owner-supplied images. The small pressed-steel wheels have flatter centers and actual oval ventilation openings within high-profile tires. Recessed headlamp bowls and small bulbs sit beneath fine rectangular lens fluting; richer amber/red segmented lamps, a rear plate panel between the tail lamps, true front apron intakes and black connected underside faces refine the classic appearance. A basic right-hand-drive cabin is visible; no engine, opening panels, exact factory trim or paint match is claimed. The sun-and-shield detail is an original simplified crest. Reference-image specifications were not independently verified. This is an artistic reconstruction, not a scanned or engineering-accurate replica.
